messages:
tara: Hey team — planning to work from Cape Town for ~6 weeks (Jul 10 / Jul 10+6w). Quick checklist: payroll, WFH stipend proration, travel insurance, equipment export, and any tax/nexus concerns? Do I need formal approval?

mike-peopleops: Short answer: yes, get manager sign-off and submit short-term remote form. For <90 days we usually keep folks on US payroll but must run a legal check. Stipend prorated monthly.

sasha-payroll: Confirming payroll: we can keep you on US payroll for stays <=90 days if you sign the short-term addendum and provide return travel proof. Stipend paid in USD and appears on US paystub; taxed normally.

legal-bot: Note: South Africa has PE rules and specific VAT/customs for goods. 6 weeks is generally low risk for PE but depends on customer-facing activity. Avoid local contracting or soliciting customers while there. We'll run counsel review (2-4 business days).

ben: Manager note  I approve, please maintain 3 hours overlap with PST core and update the team calendar with your working hours. Also confirm on-call handoffs for your week.

it-support: Equipment: shipping company laptops internationally is discouraged due to customs and warranty issues. Option A: you travel with the laptop (preferred). Option B: we can ship peripherals at your expense or reimburse receipts. Fill asset export form if shipping.

tara: Thanks. Two quick micro Qs: 1) If I rent a coworking desk locally, reimbursable? 2) Is emergency medical covered by our intl plan?

sasha-payroll: Coworking typically not covered under standard WFH stipend; exceptions possible with People Ops approval. Keep receipts and tag Expensify as "Remote-Travel".

mike-peopleops: Benefits: ping benefits@ with exact dates to verify international medical coverage. Also upload itinerary to the short-term remote form: https://intranet.redwood/forms/short-term-remote. We'll issue addendum after manager signs.

legal-bot: Counsel ticket opened. If flagged, options include shortening the trip or restricting customer-facing work.

tara: Filing form now, thanks all for fast responses :thumbsup:
